thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Hold from Maxim Group

author: Ryan Adsit
title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Hold from Maxim Group
text:
Ryan Adist - January 30, 2019, 7:45 AM EDT SHARE ON:
In a report released today, Nehal Chokshi from Maxim Group reiterated a Hold rating on Apple ( AAPL ), with a price target of $160 . yesterday at $154.68, close to its 52-week low of $142.
Chokshi observed:
“Services GM q/q & y/y trajectory disclosure paint a positive picture, but product GM trend is then even more concerning. Installed base disclosures are on a y/y basis, failing to assuage fears China iPhone installed base is now in decline. Guidance indicates further deterioration in business fundamentals. Reiterate Hold rating and 12-month price target of $160.”
 Chokshi is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 11.3% and a 58.8% success rate. Chokshi covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Super Micro Computer, and Palo Alto Networks.
Apple has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of $183.98, which is a 18.9% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 18, Longbow Research also maintained a Hold rating on the stock.

Apple’s market cap is currently $735.5B and has a P/E ratio of 13.03. The company has a Price to Book ratio of 6.86.
Based on the recent corporate insider activity of 58 insiders, corporate insider sentiment is positive on the stock. This means that over the past quarter there has been an increase of insiders buying their shares of AAPL in relation to earlier this year. Earlier this month, Albert Gore, a Director at AAPL bought 35,000 shares for a total of $507,850.
